{{Quote|It's about halfway between the equator and the north pole. Near the eastern edge of the main continent. A single mountain, rising out of forest and grassland.|Mara Jade, to Han Solo|<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>}}
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] had a '''main continent'''. [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] was situated in the northern hemisphere near the eastern edge of Wayland's main continent.<ref name="CSWE" />
